purpose: Diagnose observed midpoint gains, test partial spread execution and four strategy families with explicit adjustments
later_comparison: 2022-2025; already examined elsewhere, not untouched holdout
definition: 0 midpoint, 1 adverse bid/ask; entry and exit fractions are independent; midpoint removes all modeled crossing cost, not half
primary_metric: event-equal P&L / gross stock notional; untraded event allocations stay idle; also show premium normalized results without presenting them as account returns

single_residual.adjustment: 5% threshold, signal midpoint >= 1, full signal spread <= 10% midpoint, hybrid and market-only directional agreement, gap covers full signal spread plus commissions

vertical_relative_value.baseline: one highest relative valuation-gap opposite-residual same-expiry same-type pair per event, gross premium gap > 5%
vertical_relative_value.adjustment: both legs pass signal liquidity and model-agreement checks; gap covers signal spread cost proxy

calendar_relative_value.baseline: one highest relative valuation-gap opposite-residual same-strike same-type pair per event, gross premium gap > 5%
calendar_relative_value.adjustment: both legs pass signal liquidity and model-agreement checks; gap covers signal spread cost proxy

historical_variance.baseline: ATM straddle long if historical variance > 1.25 * implied, short if implied > 1.25 * historical
historical_variance.adjustment: signal spread <= 10%, premium >= 1, historical-final-anchored valuation agrees with side and exceeds estimated spread costs; reduce exposure according to prior-only worst earnings move

execution: same delayed entries/exits as prior experiment; initial fixed stock hedge; compare no hedge; no fabricated passive fill probabilities
diagnosis: side, event/year/name, option versus stock hedge, costs, spread, premium normalization, leave-best-events-out

second_round.hedges: Compare vendor entry deltas and same reference-IV estimator refreshed at entry, after trade selection
second_round.short_only: Earlier-period historical-variance longs lost while shorts gained; test adjusted short-only rule in later period
second_round.regime_filters: Historical forecasts assume stable risk. Test fixed variance20/variance252 <= 1.5 and 60-session drawdown >= -20%, separately and combined; signal-time returns only; all results reported, no best filter chosen

continuation.entry_limits: Reject entry ask/bid unless it preserves 20% gap versus frozen signal valuation; then test additional liquidity/minimum-entry-premium restrictions
continuation.protection: Short historical-variance straddles with nearest eligible wings at 5% or 10% of center strike; no stock hedge as primary. Preserve same core-straddle notional and match events before comparing risk. Retest signal-estimated cost budget <=25% credit.
continuation.pre_event: Signal -10 sessions, enter -9, exit -6, options expire after earnings. Test 5/10/20% current-hybrid discrepancies, liquidity/cost gate and marketable-entry limits. Initial 2021-2024 panel expanded to 2016-2020 and 2025 without changing rules.
